checks.description: Files should stay under 150 lines, counting Javadoc as one
Lines should not have trailing whitespace
Files should end with a newline
Exceptions should not end in Exception
Avoid OOP-role suffixes in class names
static final fields should be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE
Boolean methods should start with is/has/can/should
Methods should take at most 5 parameters
Methods should stay under cyclomatic complexity 10
Avoid methods with too many returns
Use enhanced for-loops over index loops
Classes should have at most 10 public methods
Avoid getters and setters (expose behavior, not state)
Indent with an even number of spaces
Avoid license boilerplate at the top of files
Method parameters should be declared final
Switch statements should have a default
Project must have a LICENSE file
Project must have a README file
Project must have a build file (pom.xml or Gradle)
Every dependency should declare a version
Libraries should have zero non-test dependencies (plugins exempt)
Packages should contain more than one file
A package should hold either files or sub-packages, not both
Every main class should have a test
Avoid duplicated code blocks across files

metrics.description: Source lines, excluding blanks and comments
Sum of cyclomatic complexity over all methods
Highest cyclomatic complexity of any method
Halstead volume of the whole codebase
Comment lines, percent of all lines
Public types and methods with Javadoc, percent
Files that failed to parse, percent
Lines added and deleted across history
Highest churn times complexity of any file
